name: Columbia (Missouri, United States)
description: Quartered blue and green by a white cross, charged at the centre with the city logo of four figures in blue and green with a lattice, the cross representing Columbia's position at the crossroads of Missouri.
history: Columbia is a city in Boone County, Missouri, and its county seat. The flag was adopted in 2016 (designed by Jon Sheltmire and chosen by a public vote among three finalists from 84 entries, reviewed by the city council in May 2016, according to Flags of the World citing the Columbia Daily Tribune).
